text_03: There are two ways to begin. For individual therapy using insurance, visit my Headway profile to check your plan, benefits, and booking options. For private-pay individual therapy, couples therapy, or breathwork, email or call me directly. You can also contact me for a free 15-minute consultation to discuss whether working together feels like a good fit.
text_04: After we confirm a time, you can add the appointment to your personal calendar (Apple, Google, or another calendar of your choice) so you have everything in one place.
